summary: MergeOptions::skip_reuc sets GIT_MERGE_FAIL_ON_CONFLICT instead of GIT_MERGE_SKIP_REUC, so conflicting merges fail and the REUC extension is still written.
The ReferenceNames iterator unwraps str::from_utf8, so a repository holding a non-UTF-8 ref name panics during iteration.
Repository::submodules asserts git_submodule_lookup succeeded inside an extern C callback, so a lookup failure aborts the process instead of returning an error.
